policy: Every requirement below is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the Lebanese General Directorate of General Security page named in source_roles. Nothing is paraphrased into an excerpt and nothing is inferred. Every excerpt was taken by line offset out of the text this project’s own fetcher retrieved, not retyped, and then re-verified against a fresh fetch.
structure_note:
This is ONE page describing a numbered table of visa sub-types — individual tourism, touristic group, student, medical, embassy appointment, transit, business, family visit and engagement — each with its own document row on top of a shared block numbered 31. The sub-type is therefore carried in every label rather than flattened into a single checklist. Flattened, this page would tell a transit passenger to produce a hotel reservation and a student to produce a plane ticket, and neither is what the authority asks of them.

The shared block matters as much as the specific rows: item 31 is what EVERY applicant files, and items 32 onward are what each adds.
freshness_note: The page publishes no dateline and no Last-Modified header, and its body references 2026. So freshness here rests on a body-year rather than on a publication date. That is recorded rather than hidden — it is the same state check-source-freshness already reports for Singapore's MOM pages, the US ESTA pages and all of Austria's migration.gv.at — and the daily sync is what will notice if the text moves.
not_extracted: The visa-type list numbered 21 to 33 near the top of the page (work visa, visit sub-purposes, artist visas). It is a catalogue rather than a set of requirements, and its numbering does not line up with the document table below it — item 33 is "visas delivered by the department of artists" in the catalogue and "individual touristic visit" in the document table. Publishing a mapping between the two would be an inference, so neither list is presented as the other.

Every fee printed as a row of zeros. The annual-residence page states several fees as `000000 lbp` and `0000,000 lbp` — the authority's own placeholders, not amounts. They are quoted nowhere here. A zero fee published as a fee would tell somebody a residence permit is free.

Routes this authority enumerates and this batch has not yet extracted: sponsorship transfer applications, the complaint procedure for an escaping foreign worker, temporary residence renewal via LibanPost, applying for a visa renewal via Liban Post, the kafala-transfer regularisation, entry of nationals from labour-supplying countries, work permits for foreign artists and musicians, and entry of artists in nightclubs. The artist, domestic-worker, religious, foreign-expert, passport-renewal and bank-statement routes named here previously are now EXTRACTED and live. Residence permits for Iraqi nationals (posts/428) is excluded on evidence: its served text refers to items (1) and (2) that are absent from the page.
The Arabic-language pages. This authority publishes an English tree and an Arabic tree; only the English tree is read, and no claim is made that the two say the same thing.

requirements.label: Who issues: General Security grants prior authorisation, requested at a regional department
requirements.description: The authority names exactly who may lodge the request, and the list is narrower than "anyone in Lebanon".
requirements.source_excerpt: 11- the general directorate of general security (previous authorization): the request is made at the regional departments by the interested party (lebanese citizen, palestinian refugee, the owner of a temporary visa, a permanent, a diplomatic, or a particular visa, as well as a residency permit of first or second class).
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 11- The general directorate of general security (previous authorization): the request is made at the regional departments by the interested party (Lebanese citizen, Palestinian refugee, the owner of a temporary visa, a permanent, a diplomatic, or a particular visa, as well as a residency permit of first or second class).

requirements.label: Lebanese missions abroad may grant visas with General Security’s authorisation
requirements.description: The second issuing channel, and it is not independent of the first.
requirements.source_excerpt: 13- lebanese missions abroad can grant visas with the authorization of the general security, and under the responsibility of the mission’s director.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 13- Lebanese missions abroad can grant visas with the authorization of the general security, and under the responsibility of the mission’s director.

requirements.label: All visas (item 31): a filled visa application, handed out by a qualifying party
requirements.description: Who may hand out the form is part of the requirement — a person residing legally in Lebanon, a touristic institution, an enterprise, a legal person or a club.
requirements.source_excerpt: -a filled visa application that is handed out by the interested party (lebanese or foreigner) residing legally in lebanon (with the exception of the 3 rd and 4 rth category) or by a touristic institution, or an enterprise (industrial, commercial, civil…), a legal person, or a club.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: -A filled visa application that is handed out by the interested party (Lebanese or foreigner) residing legally in Lebanon (with the exception of the 3 rd and 4 rth category) or by a touristic institution, or an enterprise (industrial, commercial, civil…), a legal person, or a club.

requirements.label: All visas (item 31): certified copies of the inviting party’s ID, passport and residency permit
requirements.description: Certified copies of the party in Lebanon, not of the applicant.
requirements.source_excerpt: -a certified copy of the id card, the passport and the residency permit owned by the concerned citizen.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: -A certified copy of the ID card, the passport and the residency permit owned by the concerned citizen.

requirements.label: All visas (item 31): if an enterprise or club invites, its legal documents
requirements.description: The authority gives commercial register and investment permit as its own examples.
requirements.source_excerpt: if the interested party is an enterprise, a legal person, or a club, he has to hand out all the legal documents requested (commercial register, investment permit, etc.)
requirements.source_excerpt_display: If the interested party is an enterprise, a legal person, or a club, he has to hand out all the legal documents requested (commercial register, investment permit, etc.)

requirements.label: All visas (item 31): a certified copy of a passport valid at least 6 months
requirements.description: Quoted with the authority’s own spacing (`6months`).
requirements.source_excerpt: -a certified copy of the passport that’s valid for 6months at least.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: -A certified copy of the passport that’s valid for 6months at least.

requirements.label: All visas (item 31): refugees not living in their country of origin need a 6-month resident permit
requirements.description: One of three refugee provisions on this page, each covering a different travel document.
requirements.source_excerpt: -if the refugee doesn’t live in his country of origin, or doesn’t own a foreign travelling document, he has to have in hand a resident permit for 6months at least.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: -If the refugee doesn’t live in his country of origin, or doesn’t own a foreign travelling document, he has to have in hand a resident permit for 6months at least.

requirements.label: All visas (item 31): fremmedpass or Egyptian travel document holders need a return visa valid over 6 months
requirements.description: Kept separate from the provision above because it demands different documents.
requirements.source_excerpt: if the refugee has a fremmedpas travelling document or an egyptian travelling document, he has to have in hand a certified copy of a return visa valid for more than 6months, as well as a certified copy of the residence permit.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: If the refugee has a FREMMEDPAS travelling document or an Egyptian travelling document, he has to have in hand a certified copy of a return visa valid for more than 6months, as well as a certified copy of the residence permit.

requirements.label: All visas (item 31): Palestinian passports, and Jordanian passports without a national number, need a document authorising return
requirements.description: The narrowest of the three refugee provisions and the one most easily lost in a summary.
requirements.source_excerpt: - if the refugee owns a palestinian passport, or a jordanian passport without a national number, he has to have in hand a document authorizing his return.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: - If the refugee owns a Palestinian passport, or a Jordanian passport without a national number, he has to have in hand a document authorizing his return.
